hero.title: Mobility Sculpture 01
hero.body: A KIDULTS original rights-gated editorial object. The vehicle remains generic and non-branded so the platform can discuss form, design and cultural signals without reproducing third-party trade dress.

methodology.title: Evidence before opinion
methodology.body: Signals are separated by source family, normalized, confidence-scored, reviewed and compared before publication. Preview values are explicitly labeled and never presented as verified live facts.

canon.title: From building to canonical
canon.body: Canon strength measures evidence maturity through persistence, source diversity, liquidity, cultural endurance and confidence thresholds—not popularity alone.

coverage.title: Governed expansion
coverage.body: Coverage values describe the public preview baseline. Qualified live feeds replace preview values only when numeric and verified.

research.title: Research with visible limits
research.body: V502 research presents the eight-vertical structure and current provider-independent observations. It does not treat the current Featured set as permanent ranking or market truth.

rights.title: Original by design
rights.body: The platform uses original editorial objects and avoids third-party product photography, logos, trade dress and implied endorsement.

access.title: Three access depths
access.body: Public preview explains the framework. Collector and institutional access add deeper evidence, comparables and governed workflows.

ecosystem.title: Designed for collaboration
ecosystem.body: KIDULTS is structured for culture institutions, financial institutions, data partners and research partners.
